# WPS mapping

Every [WPS](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/) 1.8.1 rule and its Rust 1.99
counterpart. Full lists sit next to this file, the preset's own reasoning in
[`lints.toml`](../lints.toml) and [`clippy.toml`](../clippy.toml). ❓ marks an open question.

| Verdict | Meaning                                    | Active | Disabled |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------ | -------- |
| ✅      | An equivalent lint is on. Tuning is noted. | 43     | 14       |
| ⚠️      | A lint covers part of the rule.            | 32     | 7        |
| 🦀      | Not applicable to Rust.                    | 79     | 37       |
| ❌      | No lint exists.                            | 44     | 9        |

Struck-through rules are disabled in WPS since 1.0, mostly left to ruff. Their ideas still hold.

## [000-099 System](wps/000-099-system.md)

| WPS rule                      | Description                                                         | Lint | Lint description | Verdict                                                   |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| WPS000 InternalErrorViolation | Happens when we get unhandled exception during the linting process. | —    | —                | 🦀 rustc and clippy crashes are ICEs that fail the build. |

## [100-199 Naming](wps/100-199-naming.md)

| WPS rule                                     | Description                                                          | Lint                                                                                                                                     | Lint description                                                                                                                                                                                          | Verdict                                                                                                    |
| -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| WPS100 WrongModuleNameViolation              | Forbid blacklisted module names.                                     | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | ❌ `disallowed_names` skips module names like `utils`.                                                     |
| WPS101 WrongModuleMagicNameViolation         | Forbid magic names (except some whitelisted ones).                   | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 🦀 No magic module names.                                                                                  |
| WPS102 WrongModuleNamePatternViolation       | Forbid module names that do not match our pattern.                   | `non_snake_case`                                                                                                                         | variables, methods, functions, lifetime parameters and modules should have snake case names                                                                                                               | ⚠️ `non_snake_case` trims `_`, so `mod _some` passes.                                                      |
| WPS110 WrongVariableNameViolation            | Forbid blacklisted variable names.                                   | `clippy::disallowed_names`                                                                                                               | usage of a disallowed/placeholder name                                                                                                                                                                    | ✅ List rewritten for Rust: keywords dropped, they cannot be names; WPS's `file` dropped too.               |
| WPS111 TooShortNameViolation                 | Forbid short variable or module names.                               | `clippy::min_ident_chars`<br>`clippy::single_char_lifetime_names`                                                                        | disallows idents that are too short<br>warns against single-character lifetime names                                                                                                                      | ✅ Stricter: 2 also flags 2-char names like `id`, WPS only 1-char ones.                                   |
| WPS112 PrivateNameViolation                  | Forbid private name pattern.                                         | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 🦀 Privacy is `pub`, not `__name`.                                                                         |
| ~~WPS113 SameAliasImportViolation~~          | Forbid using the same alias as the original name in imports.         | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | ❌ `use std::path as path` passes.                                                                         |
| WPS114 UnderscoredNumberNameViolation        | Forbid names with underscored numbers pattern.                       | `non_camel_case_types`                                                                                                                   | types, variants, traits and type parameters should have camel case names                                                                                                                                  | ⚠️ Flags `Episode_2` types; `episode_2` passes.                                                            |
| WPS115 UpperCaseAttributeViolation           | Require `snake_case` for naming class attributes.                    | `non_snake_case`<br>`non_upper_case_globals`                                                                                             | variables, methods, functions, lifetime parameters and modules should have snake case names<br>static constants should have uppercase identifiers                                                         | ✅ Associated consts stay `UPPER_CASE` in the `impl`, as idiomatic.                                        |
| WPS116 ConsecutiveUnderscoresInNameViolation | Forbid using more than one consecutive underscore in variable names. | `non_snake_case`<br>`non_camel_case_types`                                                                                               | variables, methods, functions, lifetime parameters and modules should have snake case names<br>types, variants, traits and type parameters should have camel case names                                   | ⚠️ Flags `some__value`; `SOME__VALUE` passes.                                                              |
| WPS117 ReservedArgumentNameViolation         | Forbid naming variables `self`, `cls`, or `mcs`.                     | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 🦀 `self` is a keyword.                                                                                    |
| WPS118 TooLongNameViolation                  | Forbid long variable or module names.                                | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | ❌ Length uncapped (WPS: 45).                                                                              |
| WPS119 UnicodeNameViolation                  | Forbid unicode names.                                                | `non_ascii_idents`<br>`clippy::disallowed_script_idents`                                                                                 | detects non-ASCII identifiers<br>usage of non-allowed Unicode scripts                                                                                                                                     | ✅                                                                                                         |
| WPS120 TrailingUnderscoreViolation           | Forbid trailing `_` for names that do not need it.                   | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | ❌ `name_` passes; Rust has `r#type` for keyword clashes.                                                  |
| WPS121 UnusedVariableIsUsedViolation         | Forbid using variables that are marked as unused.                    | `clippy::used_underscore_binding`<br>`clippy::used_underscore_items`                                                                     | using a binding which is prefixed with an underscore<br>using a item which is prefixed with an underscore                                                                                                 | ✅ A used `__name` slips through.                                                                          |
| WPS122 UnusedVariableIsDefinedViolation      | Forbid explicit unused variables.                                    | `clippy::no_effect_underscore_binding`<br>`let_underscore_drop`<br>`clippy::let_underscore_must_use`<br>`clippy::let_underscore_untyped` | binding to `_` prefixed variable with no side-effect<br>non-binding let on a type that has a destructor<br>non-binding `let` on a `#[must_use]` expression<br>non-binding `let` without a type annotation | ⚠️ `let _ = f();` stays allowed: it is how `unused_results` wants a result dropped.                        |
| WPS123 WrongUnusedVariableNameViolation      | Forbid unused variables with multiple underscores.                   | `clippy::just_underscores_and_digits`                                                                                                    | unclear name                                                                                                                                                                                              | ✅                                                                                                         |
| WPS124 UnreadableNameViolation               | Forbid variable or module names which could be difficult to read.    | —                                                                                                                                        | —                                                                                                                                                                                                         | ❌ `memo0output` passes.                                                                                   |
| ~~WPS125 BuiltinShadowingViolation~~         | Forbid variable or module names which shadow builtin names.          | `clippy::builtin_type_shadow`                                                                                                            | shadowing a builtin type                                                                                                                                                                                  | 🦀 Types and values live in separate namespaces.                                                           |

| WPS401 WrongDocCommentViolation                  | Forbid empty doc comments (`#:`).                                         | `clippy::empty_docs`                                                                      | docstrings exist but documentation is empty                                                                                                                                                                 | ✅                                                                            |
| WPS402 OveruseOfNoqaCommentViolation             | Forbid too many `# noqa` comments.                                        | `clippy::allow_attributes`<br>`clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason`                   | `#[allow]` will not trigger if a warning isn't found. `#[expect]` triggers if there are no warnings.<br>ensures that all `allow` and `expect` attributes have a reason                                      | ⚠️ Each suppression needs a reason, but uncapped (WPS: 10).                   |
| WPS403 OveruseOfNoCoverCommentViolation          | Forbid too many `# pragma: no cover` comments.                            | —                                                                                         | —                                                                                                                                                                                                           | ❌ WPS: 5. Nightly-only anyway.                                               |

| WPS482 ForbidLazyImportViolation                 | Forbid `lazy imports`.                                                    | —                                                                                         | —                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 🦀 `use` resolves at compile time.                                            |
| WPS483 ForbidMappingProxyTypeViolation           | `frozendict` is always better than `MappingProxyType`.                    | —                                                                                         | —                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 🦀 The borrow checker freezes the map while a view lives.                     |

## [500-599 Refactoring](wps/500-599-refactoring.md)

| WPS rule                                             | Description                                                               | Lint                                                                        | Lint description                                                                                                                                                    | Verdict                                         |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| WPS500 UselessLoopElseViolation                      | Forbid `else` without `break` in a loop.                                  | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No loop `else`.                              |
| WPS501 UselessFinallyViolation                       | Forbid `finally` in `try` block without `except` block.                   | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No `finally`.                                |
| ~~WPS502 SimplifiableIfViolation~~                   | Forbid simplifiable `if` conditions.                                      | `clippy::needless_bool`                                                     | if-statements with plain booleans in the then- and else-clause, e.g., `if p { true } else { false }`                                                                | ✅                                              |
| ~~WPS503 UselessReturningElseViolation~~             | Forbid useless `else` cases in returning functions.                       | `clippy::redundant_else`                                                    | `else` branch that can be removed without changing semantics                                                                                                        | ✅                                              |
| WPS504 NegatedConditionsViolation                    | Forbid negated conditions together with `else` clause.                    | `clippy::if_not_else`                                                       | `if` branches that could be swapped so no negation operation is necessary on the condition                                                                          | ✅                                              |
| WPS505 NestedTryViolation                            | Forbid nested `try` blocks.                                               | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No `try`.                                    |
| WPS506 UselessLambdaViolation                        | Forbid useless proxy `lambda` expressions.                                | `clippy::redundant_closure`<br>`clippy::redundant_closure_for_method_calls` | redundant closures, i.e., `\|a\| foo(a)` (which can be written as just `foo`)<br>redundant closures for method calls                                                | ✅                                              |
| ~~WPS507 UselessLenCompareViolation~~                | Forbid unpythonic zero-length compare.                                    | `clippy::len_zero`                                                          | checking `.len() == 0` or `.len() > 0` (or similar) when `.is_empty()` could be used instead                                                                        | ✅                                              |
| ~~WPS508 NotOperatorWithCompareViolation~~           | Forbid `not` with compare expressions.                                    | `clippy::nonminimal_bool`                                                   | boolean expressions that can be written more concisely                                                                                                              | ✅                                              |
| WPS509 NestedTernaryViolation                        | Forbid nesting ternary expressions in certain places.                     | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | ❌ `x + if c { 1 } else { 2 }` passes.          |
| ~~WPS510 WrongInCompareTypeViolation~~               | Forbid `in` with static containers except `set` nodes.                    | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No set literals.                             |
| ~~WPS511 UnmergedIsinstanceCallsViolation~~          | Forbid multiple `isinstance` calls on the same variable.                  | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | ❌ `matches!(x, A) \|\| matches!(x, B)` passes. |
| ~~WPS512 WrongIsinstanceWithTupleViolation~~         | Forbid multiple `isinstance` calls with single-item tuples.               | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No `isinstance`.                             |
| WPS513 ImplicitElifViolation                         | Forbid implicit `elif` conditions.                                        | `clippy::collapsible_else_if`                                               | nested `else`-`if` expressions that can be collapsed (e.g., `else { if x { ... } }`)                                                                                | ✅                                              |
| ~~WPS514 ImplicitInConditionViolation~~              | Forbid multiple equality comparisons with the same variable.              | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | ❌ `x == a \|\| x == b` passes.                 |
| WPS515 OpenWithoutContextManagerViolation            | Forbid `open()` without a context manager.                                | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 RAII closes files.                           |
| WPS516 TypeCompareViolation                          | Forbid comparing types with `type()` function.                            | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No subclassing.                              |
| WPS517 PointlessStarredViolation                     | Forbid useless starred expressions.                                       | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No unpacking.                                |
| WPS518 ImplicitEnumerateViolation                    | Forbid implicit `enumerate()` calls.                                      | `clippy::needless_range_loop`<br>`clippy::explicit_counter_loop`            | for-looping over a range of indices where an iterator over items would do<br>for-looping with an explicit counter when `_.enumerate()` would do                     | ✅                                              |
| WPS519 ImplicitSumViolation                          | Forbid implicit `sum()` calls.                                            | `clippy::unnecessary_fold`                                                  | using `fold` when a more succinct alternative exists                                                                                                                | ⚠️ `+=` loops pass.                             |
| WPS520 FalsyConstantCompareViolation                 | Forbid comparing with explicit falsy constants.                           | `clippy::comparison_to_empty`                                               | checking `x == ""` or `x == []` (or similar) when `.is_empty()` could be used instead                                                                               | ✅                                              |
| ~~WPS521 WrongIsCompareViolation~~                   | Forbid comparing values with constants using `is` or `is not`.            | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No `is`.                                     |
| WPS522 ImplicitPrimitiveViolation                    | Forbid implicit primitives in the form of `lambda` functions.             | `clippy::unwrap_or_default`<br>`clippy::unnecessary_lazy_evaluations`       | using `.unwrap_or`, etc. with an argument that constructs a default value<br>using unnecessary lazy evaluation, which can be replaced with simpler eager evaluation | ✅                                              |
| WPS523 AlmostSwappedViolation                        | Forbid unpythonic variable swaps.                                         | `clippy::almost_swapped`<br>`clippy::manual_swap`                           | `foo = bar; bar = foo` sequence<br>manual swap of two variables                                                                                                     | ✅                                              |
| WPS524 MisrefactoredAssignmentViolation              | Forbid misrefactored self assignment.                                     | `clippy::misrefactored_assign_op`                                           | having a variable on both sides of an assign op                                                                                                                     | ✅                                              |
| ~~WPS525 InCompareWithSingleItemContainerViolation~~ | Forbid comparisons where `in` is compared with single item container.     | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | ❌ `[x].contains(&y)` passes.                   |
| ~~WPS526 ImplicitYieldFromViolation~~                | Forbid `yield` inside `for` loop instead of `yield from`.                 | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 No `yield` on stable.                        |
| WPS527 NotATupleArgumentViolation                    | Require tuples as arguments for certain functions.                        | `clippy::useless_vec`                                                       | useless `vec!`                                                                                                                                                      | ⚠️ `vec![..]` where an array fits.              |
| ~~WPS528 ImplicitItemsIteratorViolation~~            | Forbid implicit `.items()` iterator.                                      | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | ❌ `map.get(k)` over `map.keys()` passes.       |
| WPS529 ImplicitDictGetViolation                      | Forbid implicit `.get()` dict method.                                     | `clippy::indexing_slicing`<br>`clippy::map_entry`                           | indexing/slicing usage<br>use of `contains_key` followed by `insert` on a `HashMap` or `BTreeMap`                                                                   | ⚠️ `contains_key` then `get` passes.            |
| WPS530 ImplicitNegativeIndexViolation                | Forbid implicit negative indexes.                                         | `clippy::get_last_with_len`<br>`clippy::indexing_slicing`                   | Using `x.get(x.len() - 1)` when `x.last()` is correct and simpler<br>indexing/slicing usage                                                                         | ✅                                              |
| ~~WPS531 SimplifiableReturningIfViolation~~          | Forbid if statements that simply return booleans in functions or methods. | `clippy::needless_bool`                                                     | if-statements with plain booleans in the then- and else-clause, e.g., `if p { true } else { false }`                                                                | ✅                                              |
| WPS532 ChainedIsViolation                            | Forbid `ast.Is` in `ast.Compare.ops` when it's size is not zero.          | —                                                                           | —                                                                                                                                                                   | 🦀 `a == b == c` does not compile.              |
| WPS533 DuplicateIfConditionViolation                 | Forbid having duplicate conditions in several `if` // `elif` branches.    | `clippy::ifs_same_cond`<br>`clippy::same_functions_in_if_condition`         | consecutive `if`s with the same condition<br>consecutive `if`s with the same function call                                                                          | ✅                                              |
| WPS534 UselessTernaryViolation                       | Forbid having useless ternary expressions.                                | `clippy::needless_match`                                                    | `match` or match-like `if let` that are unnecessary                                                                                                                 | ⚠️ Only the `Option` identity form.             |

## [600-699 OOP](wps/600-699-oop.md)

| WPS rule                                       | Description                                                             | Lint                                                                  | Lint description                                                                                                             | Verdict                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| WPS600 BuiltinSubclassViolation                | Forbid subclassing lowercase builtins.                                  | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 No inheritance: wrap in a newtype.             |
| WPS601 ShadowedClassAttributeViolation         | Forbid shadowing class level attributes with instance level attributes. | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Fields and consts live in separate namespaces. |
| WPS602 StaticMethodViolation                   | Forbid `@staticmethod` decorator.                                       | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Associated fns like `new` are idiomatic.       |
| WPS603 BadMagicMethodViolation                 | Forbid certain magic methods.                                           | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 `Drop` is core RAII.                           |
| WPS604 WrongClassBodyContentViolation          | Forbid incorrect nodes inside `class` definitions.                      | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Only items in `struct` and `impl`.             |
| WPS605 MethodWithoutArgumentsViolation         | Forbid methods without any arguments.                                   | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 A fn without `self` is an associated fn.       |
| WPS606 WrongBaseClassViolation                 | Forbid anything other than a class as a base class.                     | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Bounds must be trait paths.                    |
| WPS607 WrongSlotsViolation                     | Forbid incorrect `__slots__` definition.                                | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Fields are fixed at compile time.              |
| WPS608 WrongSuperCallViolation                 | Forbid `super()` with parameters or outside of methods.                 | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 No `super()`.                                  |
| ~~WPS609 DirectMagicAttributeAccessViolation~~ | Forbid directly calling certain magic attributes and methods.           | `clippy::explicit_deref_methods`<br>`clippy::explicit_into_iter_loop` | Explicit use of deref or deref_mut method while not in a method chain.<br>for-looping over `_.into_iter()` when `_` would do | ⚠️ `a.add(b)` passes.                             |
| WPS610 AsyncMagicMethodViolation               | Forbid certain async magic methods.                                     | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Impls must match the trait signature.          |
| WPS611 YieldMagicMethodViolation               | Forbid `yield` inside of certain magic methods.                         | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 No `yield` on stable.                          |
| WPS612 UselessOverwrittenMethodViolation       | Forbid useless overwritten methods.                                     | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 No `super()`.                                  |
| WPS613 WrongSuperCallAccessViolation           | Forbid `super()` with incorrect method or property access.              | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 No `super()`.                                  |
| WPS614 WrongDescriptorDecoratorViolation       | Forbids descriptors in regular functions.                               | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 No descriptors.                                |
| WPS615 UnpythonicGetterSetterViolation         | Forbids to use getters and setters in objects.                          | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Getters are idiomatic.                         |
| WPS616 BuggySuperContextViolation              | Calling super() in buggy context.                                       | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 No `super()`.                                  |
| WPS617 LambdaAttributeAssignedViolation        | Forbid using `lambda` as an assigned attribute.                         | —                                                                     | —                                                                                                                            | 🦀 Closures in fields are normal callbacks.       |
